company.shortDescription: Boku is a global mobile payments network providing mobile-enhanced payments in e-commerce and at physical point-of-sale.
company.description: Boku Identity is the industry's end-to-end identity verification solution. By combining identity verification and authentication capabilities with the Boku Platform, which aggregates and harmonizes mobile network operator systems across 58 countries worldwide, Boku Identity helps global enterprises across multiple industries effectively reduce identity fraud, drive conversions, ensure compliance, and deliver a superior customer experience. Boku Identity’s privacy-by-design and tokenized identity architecture enables these businesses to onboard and service their customers worldwide while maintaining security and preserving user privacy.
